title: Annotatio V §.VIII: Author retreats to presence + sacramental eating; Monica’s Evolemus (§XVI)
pass_a_gloss: The Author, scenting that Oral Eating can hardly be the native fountain of the juice of solace, says in §. XVI that the dispute between us is not about Oral Eating alone, or that of the unworthy, but also about the very presence of Christ’s Body and Blood in the Supper, and true sacramental Eating. But indeed that Christ’s body vivifies (John 6:53), and also that Christ’s Blood purges from the filth of sins, and thence as soon as either is truly distributed to those eating and drinking, the juice of solace latent in either is also offered to them, he presses in the same place, and illustrates this very thing with one and another Simile, until at last he concludes thus: So much (of Solace), he says, is situated in the Oral Eating of Christ’s Body and Blood, and in the true and real presence which that Eating suppose, that namely when by means of bread and wine we remember that we participate Christ Himself (namely oraliter), then indeed from too much joy we cry within ourselves with Monica, mother of Hippo: Let us fly away, Let us fly away — Parag. XVI.
pass_b_english: Sensing that, the Author (§.XVI) claims the dispute is not Oral alone but also presence of body and blood and true sacramental eating — body vivifies (Jn 6:53), blood purges, and solace-juice is offered with them.
He ends with Monica of Hippo: when we remember we orally participate Christ through bread and wine, we cry within from joy — Evolemus, Evolemus.
source_text: Autor subodoratus, Oralem Manducationem succi solatii fontem nativum esse haud posse, non de sola Manducatione orali, vel indignorum, sed ipsâ etiam Corp. & Sang. Christi in Cœna præsentia, verâque sacramentali Manducatione, inter nos disputari ait §. XVI. Sed verò corpus Christi vivificare Joh. 6, 53. Sanguinem etiam Christi à peccatorum sordibus purgare, indeque simulac utrumque manducantibus & bibentibus verè distribuitur, latentem quoque in utroque succum solatii, iisdem propinari, pertendit ibidem, hocque ipsum unô alióque Simili illustrat, donec tandem ita concludat: Tantum, inquit, (Solatii) in Orali Manducatione Corporis & Sanguinis Christi, & quam illa supponit, vera & reali præsentia, situm est, ut scil. ubi mediantibus pane & vino, Christum ipsum nos participare, (puta oraliter) meminimus, tùm verò præ nimio gaudio, Evolemus, Evolemus, cum Monica, Hipponensi matre, intra nos exclamemus, Parag. XVI.

lemmas.gloss: Let us fly away, Let us fly away
